evals.name: invoice-from-timesheet
evals.prompt: Here's the March timesheet export for Acme in acme-march-timesheet.json (project root). Can you turn it into a PDF invoice? Bill each entry's hours at its rate, total in dollars.
evals.expected_output: A PDF invoice from a saved definition that plans clean, reads only fields the timesheet holds, computes rounded line amounts and the total, and presents money in USD. The total is 3,027.50.

evals.name: statement-template-no-data
evals.prompt: we're about to start sending monthly account statements to customers. can you set up a quario template for it (PDF)? opening balance, that month's transactions, closing balance. we don't have the export from the billing system yet, I just want to see what it'd look like
evals.expected_output: A template: a definition plus a sample data file as its contract, a preview PDF rendered from the sample, the closing balance computed rather than stored.

evals.name: grouped-xlsx-from-orders
evals.prompt: Make an Excel sales report from orders-q3.json, grouped by region with a subtotal per region and a grand total at the bottom. Finance wants to keep working with the numbers in Excel.
evals.expected_output: An xlsx workbook from a definition that groups by region with a subtotal aggregate and a report total, amounts kept as real numbers under a format kind. The grand total is 16,283.25.

evals.name: invoice-from-messy-export
evals.prompt: Our billing system dumps invoices as JSON, northwind-2026-09.json is September's for Northwind. Make it a PDF invoice: lines with quantity, unit price and amount excl. VAT, then subtotal, VAT and total incl. VAT. It's in euros.
evals.expected_output: A PDF invoice over a snake_case, nested export with lookalike fields. Every field read exists, the subtotal is 1,798.15 and the total incl. VAT is 2,039.26, presented in EUR.

evals.name: payslip-template-no-data
evals.prompt: Set up a monthly payslip template for our staff, as a PDF. Employee details, gross pay split into salary, overtime and bonus, deductions (income tax, pension, health insurance), net pay, and year-to-date gross and net. We don't have a payroll export yet, just show me how it would look.
evals.expected_output: A many-field template: a definition and a sample file that agree field for field, a preview PDF, and gross and net pay computed rather than stored in the sample.

evals.name: invoice-tool-in-app
evals.prompt: Our app lets support staff ask Claude (Anthropic Messages API) for things. Add a tool so Claude can draft invoice PDFs with quario. Put it in src/invoice-tool.js: export the tool definition as `draftInvoice` and its handler as `handleDraftInvoice(definition, invoiceId)`. Invoices come from getInvoice(id) in src/db.js. Write the PDFs to out/. I'll wire it into our message loop myself.
evals.expected_output: A tool whose input schema is quario/schema.json and whose description names the invoice fields, and a handler that validates with plan(), returns problems for a faulty definition, and renders a clean one with data from getInvoice(), plus a passing test for it.
